verdict.rationale: Svelte's own GitHub description says it compiles components into JavaScript that 'surgically updates the DOM', which implies it manipulates real DOM nodes directly. A community user also notes the generated code is 'pretty readable'. Nothing in the evidence explicitly addresses inspecting or debugging the rendered UI in browser devtools. missing for 10: explicit documentation of devtools inspection/debugging workflow, explicit statement of no virtual DOM / real DOM node output, hands-on corroboration of debugging in browser devtools
